questions.prompt: A learner's recorder squeaks when playing C' and D'. Which practice step is most helpful?
options: Check fingering and blow gently with steady air
Blow harder and ignore the holes
questions.correctAnswer: Check fingering and blow gently with steady air
questions.explanation: Squeaks often happen when holes are not sealed well or the air is too forceful.
questions.learningOutcome: Improve recorder performance by correcting fingering and breath control.

questions.prompt: Which plan best helps a group prepare a short recorder presentation?
options: Assign notes, practise rhythm together, then listen and improve
Play different melodies loudly without practice
Hide the fingering chart from everyone
questions.correctAnswer: Assign notes, practise rhythm together, then listen and improve
questions.explanation: A group presentation improves when learners plan roles, practise together and use feedback.
questions.learningOutcome: Appreciate playing melodies using the descant recorder through group review.

questions.prompt: Which points are useful when critiquing an artwork?
options: Type, materials, media, meaning and craftsmanship
Lunch menu, shoe size and desk number
questions.correctAnswer: Type, materials, media, meaning and craftsmanship
questions.explanation: A meaningful critique considers what the work is, how it was made and what it communicates.
questions.learningOutcome: Critique creative artworks using appropriate analysis points.

questions.prompt: What is an e-gallery in Creative Arts?
options: A digital display of artworks for viewing
questions.correctAnswer: A digital display of artworks for viewing
questions.explanation: An e-gallery uses digital tools to display creative works for others to view and discuss.
questions.learningOutcome: Use digital tools to showcase and appreciate Creative Arts works.

questions.prompt: Which statement shows respectful critique of a displayed mosaic?
options: The colour contrast shows water well, and the spacing can be neater.
I will not look at any artwork.
The artist is wrong in everything.
questions.correctAnswer: The colour contrast shows water well, and the spacing can be neater.
questions.explanation: Respectful critique recognises what works and gives a specific suggestion for improvement.
questions.learningOutcome: Give respectful feedback on Creative Arts works.

questions.prompt: Which detail helps analyse a Kenyan folk dance performance?
options: Occasion, participants, instruments, costumes and formations
Only the colour of the classroom door
Only the number of exercise books
questions.correctAnswer: Occasion, participants, instruments, costumes and formations
questions.explanation: Folk dance analysis looks at cultural context and performance components.
questions.learningOutcome: Analyse Kenyan folk dance works using relevant components.

questions.prompt: Which evidence best supports appraisal of a relay performance?
options: Baton timing, lane discipline, teamwork and safety
Only the colour of the sky
Only the size of the classroom
Only the name of the whistle
questions.correctAnswer: Baton timing, lane discipline, teamwork and safety
questions.explanation: A relay appraisal should use observable performance evidence from the activity.
questions.learningOutcome: Appraise sports performance using safety, teamwork and skill execution.

questions.prompt: Which plan best combines Creative Arts works for a class appreciation day?
options: Display artworks, perform music and dance, demonstrate games, then give respectful feedback
Lock all works away and cancel presentations
Let everyone shout at once with no order
Show only broken tools without explanation
questions.correctAnswer: Display artworks, perform music and dance, demonstrate games, then give respectful feedback
questions.explanation: An appreciation day should let learners view, perform, demonstrate and discuss Creative Arts works respectfully.
questions.learningOutcome: Plan an appreciation activity that connects creating, performing and critique.
